fields.question: Which team is practicing continuous integration?
options: Each developer merges to main at least daily, and every merge triggers an automated build and test run

fields.explanation: Continuous integration is frequent merging plus an automated build and test of the merged result, so an integration problem surfaces within minutes of the merge that caused it. A nightly build does test the merged result but delays that feedback by up to a day, and local testing never exercises the combination with everyone else's work. Automatic deployment describes what happens after the checks; on its own it says nothing about how often changes are integrated or whether anything is tested.

notes: Reworded distractor keeps the CI-versus-delivery contrast without entailing CI, and the explanation's last sentence was adjusted to match.
